cohort: 339 pregnant women with high childbirth fear (W-DEQ A ≥ 66) in south-east Queensland, Australia
finding: Midwife-led psycho-education for women with childbirth fear during pregnancy is cost-effective and leads to improved vaginal birth rates and reduced caesarean section numbers.
mod_finding: Women receiving psycho-education had a higher likelihood of vaginal birth compared to controls.
